# binutils / fuzz_bfd

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `fuzz_bfd` ([source](source/fuzz_bfd.c), unmodified) over binutils-gdb (sourceware.org/git/binutils-gdb at d3631873).

Writes the input to a temp file, bfd_openr with the default target, bfd_check_format(bfd_archive); nothing is checked.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against binutils-gdb at commit d3631873.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- bfd_init() must return BFD_INIT_MAGIC, else abort; a one-time library ABI sanity check that is true for any correctly linked build, independent of the input ([lines 46-47](source/fuzz_bfd.c#L46-L47)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
